differences: The proposed method focuses on dynamic graph-level embedding and addressing structural visit bias and abrupt evolution blindness, while Sketch-DBH targets subgraph partitioning in graph streams.
EvoFormer uses a Structure-Aware Transformer Module and an Evolution-Sensitive Temporal Module, whereas Sketch-DBH employs Count-Min Sketch and a minimum heap for efficient partitioning.
cards.main_contribution: Proposed a new edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm, called Sketch-DBH, for handling subgraph partitioning problems in large-scale graph stream data.

quotes.interpretation: EvoFormer is designed to address specific challenges in dynamic graph-level representation learning, such as structural visit bias and abrupt evolution blindness.
quotes.quote: To overcome these challenges, we propose EvoFormer, an evolution-aware Transformer framework tailored for dynamic graph-level representation learning.
